description: Non-CityGML input written as nested CityGML through attributeKeys: four GeoJSON polygons, a building b1, walls w1 and w2 naming b1 as their parent, and window win1 naming w1, each with its class, gml:id, LOD and parent under its own attribute names (kind, id, level, parent). The writer must nest both walls in b1's bldg:boundedBy and the window in w1's bldg:opening. New-world only: the legacy converter reads LOD from typed CityGML geometry, not attributes.
